exactPrompt: SCENE 1871 - KYRGYZSTAN, ISSYK-KUL DRY PUBLIC LAKESIDE PROMENADE. Create one original photorealistic cinematic vertical 9:16 sci-fi travel-editorial still. The cast is exactly four fictional adult women, every one exactly age 21 and female-only: blonde Radiance, dark-haired Ellie, Black Alia, and brunette AI ECE. No other people. The three attached reference images, uploaded in authoritative order as scenes 938, 936, and 937, are identity-only anchors for this recurring fictional quartet; preserve their canonical faces and role mapping while creating a wholly new pose, wardrobe, setting, and composition. Public-safe adult presentation only. Use bold distinct high-fashion party and runway couture with varied satin, lace-over-opaque, lacquered latex-look, metallic, and structured materials; every short silhouette must be secure, fully opaque, and lined, mixing mini-dresses with clearly divided skorts or mini-skirts. Use abstract Kyrgyz-inspired mountain-line, felt-shyrdak, lake-wave, walnut-leaf, yurt-lattice, and sun-ray geometry in cobalt, turquoise, saffron, crimson, ivory, black, silver, and gold, but no literal flag, official symbol, national emblem, or text. No religion, sacred sites, monuments, government, politics, uniforms, weapons, tactical props, animals, bystanders, letters, logos, watermarks, nudity, explicit sexuality, minors, or real-person identity. Place the quartet on a broad, dry, level paved promenade well back from the water, with the immense turquoise Issyk-Kul horizon, pale shore, rhythmic poplars, and snow-streaked Tian Shan wall creating an unmistakable secular location read; no boats, rails as props, wet surfaces, or shoreline approach. Freeze a controlled runway half-step: Ellie deliberately steadies Alia by forearm and shoulder, Alia gives ECE one brief consensual cheek peck, and Radiance answers with a theatrical playful jealous crossed-wrist pose and lifted brow. ECE then reaches for Radiance and all four close into a warm reconciled hand-linked ring. Radiance wears crimson-turquoise lace-over-opaque two-piece with a clearly divided mini-skirt; Ellie black-silver structured felt-shyrdak skort couture; Alia saffron-gold satin mini-dress with walnut-leaf geometry; ECE ivory-turquoise metallic mini-dress with lake-wave facets. Suggest a gentle stabilized pedestal rise followed by a slow lateral pan, entirely above the dry promenade. CAMERA ROLL 53/100 - INTERMEDIATE FRAMING. Show all four women in one cohesive composition and crop strictly at the knees. Do not show lower legs or footwear. Keep the location broad, legible, and unmistakable. The protective steady, cheek peck, playful jealousy, and reconciliation must all read instantly within this exact crop. No water contact, edge approach, leaning, running, jumping, tripping, stumbles, falls, or unsafe motion.
